title: Ending The Data Format Wars
summary: A deep dive on 4 different data serialization formats
body_markdown:
# Summary


This talk was presented at the[DevOpsUT Meetup](https://www.meetup.com/devopsut/photos/33650149/) . It covers 4 different ways to store data in a text format. It compares and contrasts the formats to dispel the common notion that any one format is objectively the best.


# Details


The full source code for the talk can be found at:


- [https://github.com/carsonoid/talk-ending-the-data-format-wars](https://github.com/carsonoid/talk-ending-the-data-format-wars)
